label: No hook, generator or CI step writes a doc version automatically; the engine's only write mode is apply, it is invoked by nothing automated, the compute manifest is gitignored, and templates seed literals at authoring time only.

The only automatic check on a version value is the post-edit plugin's gate row, which runs presence+format only with no git and no manifest, so no automated surface can detect stored-vs-derived drift.

No git hook checks a doc version at all: the installed pre-commit runs comment-hygiene, template-phrase-lint, mirror and skill-authoring gates, and a ripgrep for frontmatter across the hook directory returns zero matches.
CI's frontmatter guard does not know the version field exists; its contract is title, description, trigger_phrases, importance_tier and contextType, so CI cannot fail on any version value.
The engine's own .mjs test suite is not wired into CI: the sk-doc CI job runs run-script-tests.sh, which loops over test_*.py only, and no workflow references test-frontmatter-version.mjs.
.opencode/skills and .opencode/agents are symlinks into .skilled, so every CI and hook path naming .opencode executes the same physical files rather than a second copy.

direction: Automated writer or value-checker hidden in a git hook or CI step
